summary: Full end-to-end testing of new JWT Bearer-token admin authentication. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (login correct/wrong-pass/unknown-email, /auth/me with/without/garbage token, admin gate 401 without + 200 with token across 4 admin endpoints, garbage token 401, public endpoints /api/ and /api/insights NOT gated). Frontend: 14/14 Playwright checks pass (unauthed /admin -> /admin/login redirect, wrong-password inline error, successful login lands on admin-home-page with token persisted in localStorage key 'filed_admin_token', protected pages /admin/nirf, /review, /metrics, /intelligence, /refresh load without bouncing, session persists on /admin reload, nav-logout clears token and re-redirects to login, public pages /, /colleges, /compare load and show nav-admin link).

issues: Recharts console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container has unset width/height during initial render. Not blocking, but worth setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer wrappers.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height(-1) warnings on admin pages by giving ResponsiveContainer parents a fixed height or min dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt hashing + JWT (HS256, 12h exp) — clean, uses JWT_SECRET from env, type-checked 'access' claim. Good.
seed_admin is correctly idempotent and re-syncs password if .env changes (matches playbook).
Middleware in server.py gates only /api/admin/* and excludes OPTIONS — correct for CORS preflight.

CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router and AFTER the admin middleware definition; FastAPI applies middlewares bottom-up so order is fine, but with CORS_ORIGINS='*' AND allow_credentials=True the browser will reject credentialed requests (auth uses Bearer header, not cookies, so practically ok, but configuration is technically invalid per CORS spec). Recommend setting explicit origins in production.

/api/auth/me returns 401 with FastAPI's default {'detail':...} but middleware returns {'detail': 'Admin authentication required'} — minor inconsistency in error shape between gate (middleware) and explicit auth endpoints; not blocking.
JWT_SECRET is checked in .env (good); auth._secret() will raise KeyError if missing — fail-fast behavior is acceptable.
server.py is 671 lines — close to the 700-line threshold; consider extracting admin routers into separate module files.
